snippet.title: Escape: Immersion | Official Teaser | Underwater VHS Horror Adventure Game
snippet.description:
Escape: Immersion is an atmospheric horror adventure set inside a collapsing underwater military base. Flooding corridors, failing lights, and something unknown hiding in the dark.

🗓️ Release planned for July 2026.

Add to wishlist:
